title: The Son of Man
aka: one like a son of man
lead: In Hebrew and Aramaic, "son of man" simply means a human being (Psalm 8:4; Ezekiel 2:1). Daniel sees "one like a son of man" coming with the clouds to the Ancient of Days and receiving an everlasting kingdom (Daniel 7:13–14). In the Gospels "the Son of Man" is the name Jesus uses for himself more than any other (Mark 2:10; Mark 14:62), the Parables of 1 Enoch make the Son of Man a heavenly judge (1 Enoch 46; 1 Enoch 48), and Revelation sees the risen Jesus as one like a son of man (Revelation 1:13).
